meta.name: ulw-execute
meta.description: Execute a Prometheus work plan with Boulder state, evidence ledger updates, worktree discipline, parallel subagents, and Stop-hook continuation. Use after planning when the user says ulw-execute, execute plan, continue plan, resume plan, or asks to run a .omo/plans plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动执行开发计划，并行调度多个子代理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 你希望让代理按既定计划自动推进开发任务。
copy.tagline_en: Execute your development plan automatically while coordinating parallel subagents.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to follow a defined plan and handle multiple subtasks in parallel.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会接管一份工作计划并执行到底。它自己不动手干活,而是把任务拆小、派给多个子代理并行做,同时记录进度和证据,直到所有任务完成。
howto.when: 在完成规划后,当你说“ulw-execute”“execute plan”等指令,或要求运行 .omo/plans 下的计划时触发。

say.note: 开始执行当前选定的计划。

say.text: 执行计划,按 .omo/plans 里的方案来
say.note: 进入执行流程,自动分派子代理。

say.text: 继续执行计划,把剩下的任务跑完

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude runs a work plan to completion. It never implements; it splits tasks into units and dispatches parallel subagents, tracking progress and evidence until every checkbox is done.
howto.when_en: Triggers after planning when you say “ulw-execute”, “execute plan”, etc., or ask to run a plan under .omo/plans.

say_en.note: Starts executing the currently selected plan.

say_en.text: Continue the plan and finish the rest
